Roshan Shaji is a name that's quickly gaining fame throughout India's tech, education, and business scenes. Recently featured by ANI as one of the "10 Inspiring Personalities To Look Out In 2025" (Read the ANI article), Roshan Shaji's multi-faceted journey is inspiring a new generation of changemakers in Kerala and beyond.

From Tech Roots to Entrepreneurial Heights

A proud M.Tech graduate from CET Trivandrum, Roshan Shaji founded DanRosh Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd to deliver next-level branding, web development, and digital marketing that help businesses—big and small—scale and succeed. His knack for combining technical precision with grassroots collaboration has powered growth for local enterprises and led DanRosh Tech to international recognition. What sets Roshan Shaji apart is his commitment to understanding each client's unique challenges and crafting tailored digital solutions that drive measurable results. From startups to established brands, his approach focuses on sustainable growth through innovation and strategic thinking.

International Partnership, Global Impact

Roshan Shaji's vision for collaborative growth took DanRosh Tech global through a strategic partnership with Dan Laye, CEO of WebWeavers.tech, Slovenia (EU). This alliance merges South Indian ingenuity with European innovation, positioning their ventures—DanRosh Tech, WebWeavers.tech, and the sustainable platform EcoCart.co.in—at the forefront of digital transformation. This international collaboration has enabled Roshan Shaji to bring world-class technology standards to the Indian market while showcasing Kerala's tech talent on a global stage. The partnership represents a new model for cross-border innovation, where diverse perspectives and expertise combine to create solutions that benefit businesses worldwide.

Leading AI Education and Business Networks

Beyond his entrepreneurial pursuits, Roshan Shaji is revolutionizing how India learns about AI. As Head of IBN AI Academy and CTO at IBNSU (ibnsu.com), he designs practical, real-world curriculum to empower students, professionals, and aspiring entrepreneurs. His teaching blends industry best practices with hands-on mentorship, giving learners the tools and confidence to drive the next wave of intelligent technology. Roshan Shaji's educational approach stands out for its focus on practical applications rather than just theory. He believes in making AI accessible to everyone, regardless of their technical background, and his courses reflect this philosophy by breaking down complex concepts into actionable insights that can be immediately applied in real-world scenarios.

At IBNSU, Roshan Shaji leads cutting-edge business solutions, branding, and media strategies—building a vibrant network of entrepreneurs, investors, and talent united by innovation, integrity, and impact. His role extends beyond traditional CTO responsibilities, as he actively mentors young entrepreneurs and helps them navigate the complexities of building tech-driven businesses in today's rapidly evolving digital landscape. Through IBNSU, Roshan Shaji has created an ecosystem where ideas flourish, partnerships form organically, and innovation becomes a shared journey rather than a solitary pursuit.

A Champion of Sustainability

With EcoCart.co.in, Roshan Shaji supports eco-friendly living by connecting consumers with local artisans and sustainable brands. His work doesn't just foster business—it builds communities committed to positive change. Through this platform, Roshan Shaji demonstrates his commitment to environmental responsibility and economic empowerment. He understands that sustainable development is not just about environmental protection but also about creating economic opportunities for local communities and preserving traditional crafts for future generations. Learn more about sustainable living at EcoCart.

Why Roshan Shaji Stands Out

  • ANI’s “10 Inspiring Personalities To Look Out In 2025” honoree (See full article).
  • Founder, DanRosh Tech Solutions—Empowering digital transformation across industries.
  • International Partner—Working with Dan Laye (WebWeavers.tech, EU Slovenia) for borderless innovation.
  • Head of IBN AI Academy & CTO at IBNSU—Democratizing AI education and building values-driven business networks.
  • EcoCart.co.in Leader—Fostering sustainable commerce and local economic growth.

Roshan Shaji's inspiring story embodies the promise of technology as a force for good. His visionary leadership is actively shaping Kerala's future, inspiring thousands of entrepreneurs, and proving that true innovation means meaningful impact—local and global, today and tomorrow.

Read more about Roshan and other trailblazers in ANI’s exclusive feature: 10 Inspiring Personalities To Look Out In 2025.

title.raw: All Eyes on Rafah: A City at the Crossroads of Conflict
title.rendered: All Eyes on Rafah: A City at the Crossroads of Conflict

content.raw:
All Eyes on Rafah

Introduction

All eyes are on Rafah, a city straddling the border between the Gaza Strip and Egypt, as it becomes a focal point in the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict. With its strategic location and historical significance, Rafah is more than just a border town; it is a symbol of resilience and struggle. This article delves into the current situation in Rafah, its historical context, and the humanitarian crisis unfolding in the region.

The Historical Significance of Rafah

Rafah's history is marked by its role as a border town between various empires and nations. From the ancient battles between Egyptian and Syrian powers to its division in the 20th century, Rafah has always been at the heart of geopolitical struggles. The town was split in 1982 following Israel's withdrawal from the Sinai Peninsula, creating a buffer zone that disrupted the lives of its residents.

The Current Crisis

In recent months, all eyes have turned to Rafah as it becomes a refuge for over a million displaced Palestinians, fleeing the violence in northern Gaza. The city's population has swelled, leading to overcrowded conditions and a severe humanitarian crisis. The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) have intensified their operations in Rafah, targeting what they claim are Hamas strongholds.

Humanitarian Concerns

The humanitarian situation in Rafah is dire. With the closure of the Rafah border crossing, the main artery for aid into Gaza, the flow of essential supplies has been severely restricted. The United Nations and various humanitarian organizations have warned of an impending catastrophe if the situation does not improve. The lack of access to clean water, food, and medical supplies has exacerbated the suffering of the civilian population.

The International Response

The international community has expressed deep concern over the escalating violence in Rafah. Countries like Spain, Ireland, and Norway have formally recognized the statehood of Palestine, while the United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire to prevent further loss of life. Despite these calls, the conflict shows no signs of abating, with both sides holding firm on their demands.

The Path Forward

The future of Rafah remains uncertain. As negotiations continue in Cairo, the hope for a lasting ceasefire hinges on the willingness of both parties to make concessions. The reopening of the Rafah border crossing is crucial for alleviating the humanitarian crisis and providing relief to the beleaguered residents of Gaza.

Conclusion

All eyes are on Rafah as it stands as a testament to the enduring human spirit in the face of adversity. As the world watches, the fate of this border town will be a litmus test for the broader Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The international community must act swiftly to ensure that Rafah does not become a forgotten casualty in this protracted struggle.

Call to Action

Stay informed about the situation in Rafah and support humanitarian efforts by donating to organizations providing aid to the region. Share this article to raise awareness and keep the spotlight on Rafah. #All Eyes on Rafah
